messages:
Ran: quick heads-up. started v5q3-int3 canary at 08:10. rerank cohort shows NDCG@10 dip at 15% weight — small but consistent across windows.

Simone: How small? numbers plz.

Ran: Snapshot (15% weight, 9k requests):
- NDCG@10 rerank: -0.62% abs vs baseline-v4
- longdoc hallucination: +1.1% abs (slice size ~2.2k)
- latency p95: +40ms (taily on rerank heavy flows)
- token cost: -30%

Jess: deploy-bot: canary started at 08:10, region=eu-central-1, init_weight=10%, rolling to 15% now. No infra alerts.

deploy-bot: rollout:update model=v5q3-int3 weight=15% by=Jess

Vik: Re: NDCG drop — product cares about rerank metric more than overall MRR. We can't accept >0.5% NDCG regression without gating.

Simone: Proposed automatic gating rules (draft):
```
- global_min_samples: 4000
- rerank_ndcg_threshold: 0.5% abs
- longdoc_halluc_threshold: 1.0% abs
- latency_p95_threshold: slo_p95 + 35ms
- significance: two-sided, p<0.05
- bayesian_stop: bayes_factor>10 favors baseline -> immediate halt
- hysteresis_windows: 2 consecutive windows
- ignore_initial_warmup: 20m
```

Ran: longdoc sample < global_min_samples right now (2.2k) so signal is noisy. suggest per-slice min to 3k for longdoc and require bayes_factor check before hard rollback.

Jess: Ops: add sticky-session guard. If >50% sessions in a cohort are pinned and that cohort regresses, do cohort-only fallback before global. Last time pinning amplified regression.

data-dog-bot: alert: rerank ndcg drop breach (0.62%) at 08:33 for canary=v5q3-int3; alert level=warning; sample_count=9200

Vik: Can we use traffic annealing instead of big jumps? ie. step sizes: 10% -> 20% -> 30% with 20m observation windows. If composite metric (ndcg_drop_scaled + hallucination_weighted) > composite_threshold -> soft rollback.

Simone: Agree to anneal. Also propose soft vs hard fallback rules: soft = reduce by 50% of canary weight for 30m + auto-recheck; hard = full rollback and block promotion until manual review. Soft triggered by single-window breach, hard triggered by 2 windows OR bayes stop.

Ran: implement composite metric defined as: 0.7 * ndcg_drop_normalized + 0.3 * hallucination_delta_normalized. composite_threshold = 0.6 (tuned). I'll push this to alert rules.

Jess: Ops will create runbook snippet: how to escalate soft->hard, where to check kv-cache warmup (cold path shows spike in hallucination), and how to inspect session pinning histograms.

Simone: Decision for now: pause further ramp to 20% and enable rerank extra telemetry (NDCG per-query distribution) + longdoc per-slice min_samples bump to 3k. Soft rollback policy enabled with automatic incident creation.

deploy-bot: Canary weight updated to 20% at 08:45.

Ran: I'll watch the bayes_factor on rerank overnight. If bayes_factor >10 in favor of baseline or ndcg_drop >1% at any step -> immediate hard rollback.

Vik: Please tag this run eval-id: eval-2026-03-v5q3-ndcg-01 and add to the promotion-blocklist until postmortem if hard rollback occurs.

Simone: thanks. low risk plan locked. ping channel if any escalations. :metal:
